# Schedule feed polling from the ingestion queue

## Context and Problem Statement

Per-feed backoff state lived in the fetcher's memory, so a restart reset every
interval to five minutes and produced a fetch storm.

## Decision Outcome

Polling is driven by delayed messages on the queue introduced in [[000003]]. The
next fetch time is the message's visibility deadline, so the schedule is durable
and a restart changes nothing.

## Consequences

The fetcher becomes stateless. Rescheduling a feed now means republishing a
message rather than mutating memory.
